prompt: Help me plan post three of the Legal Framework series. I've been using Hindsight for a month instead of my own memory scripts. Recall is better, but I lost the OKF one-fact-per-file discipline and I'm not sure that matters anymore.
assertions: Offers two or three candidate one-liners for the point, rather than one
Names the reader: who they are, what they believe now, what should change
Proposes at least two arcs written as numbered beats, and recommends one with a reason
Marks turning points as what the reader should see or do, not how to build a visual
Includes honesty beats (what isn't solved or what went wrong first)
Marks missing evidence as 'author to supply' (or equivalent) instead of inventing facts, numbers or anecdotes
Contains no drafted body paragraphs of the post
Points back to posts one and two of the series by name or slug
Plans an honesty beat around losing the OKF one-fact-per-file discipline
Asks what 'better recall' means and how it was measured
Shows what at least two candidate phrasings of the point would each include or leave out
Leaves the brief unlocked and runs (or explicitly defers until the wording is chosen) a check of every beat against the point's wording
